info.name: NY Add Baggage Flow (RideOTP)
info.description:
RideOTP flow + add baggage before ride starts: search in special zone -> confirm quote -> add baggage (fare recalculated) -> verify booking fare changed -> driver starts with OTP -> end.

Prerequisites: same as 08-RideOtpFlow.json. AddBaggage endpoint must be wired and a fare policy with non-zero perLuggageCharge must be configured for the booked vehicle tier in the special zone.
